Quick test
go install github.com/djburkhart/gcpgrlx/cmd/gcpgrlx@v0.3.0
gcpgrlx validate -f .\examples\microservices.yaml
gcpgrlx render -f .\examples\microservices.yaml -out .\dist
grlx cook .\dist\deploy.grlx -T gcp-runner --test

Minimal input.

Describe services, jobs, rollout controls, networking, Caddy routes, and probes in YAML instead of constructing long deploy commands by hand.

Deterministic output.

Review the generated deploy.grlx file before you run it so the deployment flow stays transparent.

Easy testing.

Validate, render, dry-run with grlx cook --test, and attach smoke tests to verify the rollout path end to end.

Workflow

A simple path from config to generated recipe.

Use the docs site like a reference sheet: see a real input file, the commands to run, the generated .grlx output, and how Caddy and post-deploy verification fit into the same rollout.

  1. 1. Start from examples\microservices.yaml or generate a sample with init.
  2. 2. Run validate, plan, and render-caddy to inspect the deployment shape and edge routing.
  3. 3. Run render to generate dist\deploy.grlx, then dry-run it through grlx.
